name: Perga
overview: Perga, identified as the capital of Pamphylia, is a significant location in the early ministry of Paul as recorded in Acts. After departing from Paphos, Paul and his companions arrived at Perga, where John Mark left them and returned to Jerusalem. The Scripture highlights that Paul preached the word in Perga before continuing their journey to Antioch in Pisidia and later to Attalia, underscoring Perga as a key city in the spread of the gospel during Paul's first missionary journey.
